period.time_scale: UTC (ISO 8601, 'Z'); internally TDB seconds past J2000 via naif0012.tls

frames.azimuth_elevation: site local horizontal frame: azimuth clockwise from north (N=0,E=90), elevation above the plane normal to the radial; apparent (LT+S)
frames.sun_direction_moon_me / earth_direction_: unit vector from the MOON CENTRE to the body in MOON_ME (apparent, LT+S). Use these (through the render matrix) for global lighting; never apply site azimuth/elevation to the globe.
